verdict.rationale: Nix is a local, open-source package manager and OS build system. It has no hosted service that ingests user content, so an opt-out from AI-model training is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Nix collecting user data or offering any AI-training controls that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
